description: Android Kotlin source code for HomeFragment class implementing a TV-optimized home screen UI with horizontally scrolling rows of media cards, custom presentation, focus effects, and progress indicators.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment class implementing the TV home screen with multiple rows displaying media cards including 'Continue Watching' and 'TV Channels'.

methods.name: buildUI
methods.description: Builds the user interface, setting up headers, rows, and click/selection handlers.

methods.name: buildListRow
methods.description: Creates a ListRow with a header and a list of CardItems.

methods.name: buildContinueWatchingItems
methods.description: Generates sample CardItems for the 'Continue Watching' row.

methods.name: buildTvChannelItems
methods.description: Generates sample CardItems for the 'TV Channels' row.

properties.name: rowsAdapter
properties.description: Adapter managing the list of rows.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: Data class representing a media card's content including title, image, progress, and size preference.

classes.name: CardPresenterSelector
classes.description: Selects the custom presenter for CardItems.

classes.name: OPImageCardPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter for media cards implementing focus effects, image, title, and progress bar.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view holder with a customized ImageCardView.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from CardItem to the view, setting images, title, size, and adding progress bar.

methods.name: buildProgressBar
methods.description: Constructs a custom progress bar view matching card progress.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Cleans up view holder to free resources.
